combos.reason: Texas wins, Oregon with a first-time starting quarterback doesn't blow out unbeaten UCLA, and Louisville doesn't win by a touchdown against a Florida State team the market keeps moving toward.

cfb:26OCT09FSULOU.lean: Louisville not to win by 7 or more: the betting market keeps moving toward Florida State, and the Seminoles' ground game should keep this within a touchdown.
news: Florida State has 18 players ruled out, including running back Samuel Singleton, receiver Devin Carter and several linebackers and defensive backs (SI, Tomahawk Nation).
Louisville quarterback Lincoln Kienholz is probable after being questionable last week; defensive captain Koen Entringer returns after missing two weeks (SI, Yahoo).
The line opened with Louisville favored by 6 and has dropped to about 3.5, a move toward Florida State (SI betting preview).
Louisville's defense has given up at least 27 points in each of its three losses; Florida State quarterback Ashton Daniels is a running threat with nine rushing touchdowns (SI, Predictem).
Warm and dry at an outdoor stadium; no weather concern.
cfb:26OCT09FSULOU.summary: Louisville is favored by about 3 to 4 at home tonight, but the line has moved toward Florida State all week and most analysts like the Seminoles to keep it close. Florida State has a long injury list (18 players already ruled out), while Louisville gets quarterback Lincoln Kienholz and defensive captain Koen Entringer back.

cfb:26OCT09IOWAWASH.lean: Slight lean to Washington with Iowa's backup quarterback starting, but the Kalshi board here only offers the Iowa side and the under prices are no bargain. No strong lean.
news: Iowa will start Jeremy Hecklinski; Hank Brown is out with an upper-body injury, per On3's Pete Nakos and Hawkeye beat writers.
Hecklinski has not started a college game; he was 5-for-5 in relief against Ohio State (Hawk Fanatic).
Washington gets two-year starting center Landen Hatchett back for the first time this season (Seattle Times via Union-Bulletin).
Demond Williams Jr. has been sacked 12 times in the past two weeks, tied for most in the country (Yahoo).
Husky Stadium is outdoors; about a 50 percent chance of rain at kickoff.
Most analysts favor the under on the total; the spread picks are split between Washington by a field goal and Iowa with the points (Covers, DraftKings Network).
cfb:26OCT09IOWAWASH.summary: Iowa's starting quarterback Hank Brown is out with a throwing-shoulder sprain, so backup Jeremy Hecklinski makes his first career start tonight on a short week at Husky Stadium, which is outdoors with rain in the forecast. Washington's quarterback Demond Williams Jr. has been sacked a lot and the Huskies are missing several running backs, so analysts expect a low-scoring game.

cfb:26OCT10INDNEB.lean: Indiana not to win by 12 or more. The wind, the home crowd and Nebraska's clean bill of health make a one-score game more likely than a rout.
news: Local forecasters expect south winds of 20 to 30 mph with gusts to 40 mph during the game (1011now, KSNB).
Injury reports are clean for both sides: Indiana is missing backup running back Khobie Martin, tight end Andrew Barker and corner Carson Williams; no Nebraska starters are out (247Sports).
Indiana quarterback Josh Hoover has thrown 15 touchdowns and no interceptions; Nebraska averages almost 10 penalties a game, fifth most in the country (SI, Adam Carriker).
Analysts are split: Covers and DocSports take Nebraska with the points, citing a look-ahead spot before Ohio State; the SP+ model has Indiana winning by a touchdown.
Indiana has covered the spread just once this season; Nebraska has covered four of five (FanDuel Research).
cfb:26OCT10INDNEB.summary: Two unbeaten teams in Lincoln. Indiana is favored by about 7 or 8, but Nebraska is 5-0 at home with a mobile quarterback in Anthony Colandrea, and Saturday's forecast calls for near-record heat with wind gusts near 40 mph. Indiana has covered only once in five games this year.

cfb:26OCT10STANND.lean: No strong lean. The blowout is priced in, and going over the total depends almost entirely on Notre Dame alone scoring into the 50s.
news: Notre Dame corner Leonard Moore (concussion) and linebacker Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa (thumb) are questionable; safety Brauntae Johnson and lineman Jason Onye are out (On3, ESPN).
Stanford's leading receiver Caden High is questionable and corner Brandon Nicholson is out (NDNation).
Quarterback CJ Carr has 13 touchdowns against one interception (One Foot Down).
The line opened at 35.5 and has moved to 38.5; about 86 percent of the money is on Notre Dame (WagerTalk). Covers projects 52-7.
cfb:26OCT10STANND.summary: Notre Dame is favored by close to 40 and the line has climbed from 35.5, with most of the money on the Irish. Notre Dame's two best defenders, Leonard Moore and Kyngstonn Viliamu-Asa, are questionable, but Stanford's offense ranks near the bottom of the country and the Cardinal have lost conference games by 39, 28 and 54.

cfb:26OCT10TEXOKLA.lean: Texas to win is the safest call on the board, and Texas winning by 8 or more is a fair price given how little Oklahoma has scored.
news: Oklahoma rules out five players including receiver Trell Harris, running back Xavier Robinson and defensive back Jacobe Johnson; left tackle Michael Fasusi is doubtful (247Sports Thursday report).
Texas running back Hollywood Smothers is off the injury report and tight end Nick Townsend is probable (Burnt Orange Nation, Hook'em Headlines).
Oklahoma hasn't scored more than 14 points in its last three games and has allowed nine sacks in four games (Predictem, SI).
Every CBS Sports writer picks Texas; Covers puts Texas at about a 3-in-4 chance to win and predicts 24-13.
Some books have moved Texas from a 7.5-point favorite to 8.5 or 9.5 (Covers, Predictem). Hot and dry in Dallas.
cfb:26OCT10TEXOKLA.summary: Top-ranked Texas is favored by a touchdown or more at the Cotton Bowl, and Oklahoma's offense has been a mess, failing to score more than 14 points in any of its last three games. Oklahoma has five players out and its starting left tackle doubtful, while Texas gets running back Hollywood Smothers and tight end Nick Townsend back.

cfb:26OCT10TXAMMIZZ.lean: No strong lean. Missouri should win, but the price for a Missouri blowout isn't attractive and the injured safeties give A&M a puncher's chance.
news: Missouri running back Ahmad Hardy will not play; coach Eli Drinkwitz says he hasn't practiced yet (Yahoo, CBS).
Missouri lists safeties Santana Banner and Kensley Louidor-Faustin and linebacker Robart Woodyard Jr. as questionable; three of their top four tacklers (Gig Em Gazette).
Texas A&M receiver Terry Bussey is out for the season and Mario Craver is questionable (SI).
Marcel Reed has been pressured on over 40 percent of his dropbacks this year (Covers).
Missouri quarterback Austin Simmons has yet to throw an interception this season.
cfb:26OCT10TXAMMIZZ.summary: Missouri is favored by about 3 at home. Star running back Ahmad Hardy is still out recovering from an offseason gunshot wound, and Missouri's safeties are banged up, but Texas A&M has struggled to protect quarterback Marcel Reed and lost receiver Terry Bussey for the season. Most analysts side with Missouri.

cfb:26OCT10UCLAORE.lean: Oregon not to win by 14 or more. A first-time starter and several missing starters against the best offense Oregon has faced makes a two-touchdown win a lot to ask.
news: Dante Moore is out for Saturday; Dylan Raiola will start (ESPN, Big Ten injury report).
Oregon also lists receiver Jeremiah McClellan (broken foot), running back Simeon Price and lineman Trent Ferguson (out for the season) as out; safety Aaron Flowers is doubtful (On3, Yahoo).
UCLA receivers Mikey Matthews and Jonah Smith and lineman Sam Yoon are out (ClutchPoints).
Raiola has completed 30 of 36 passes with five touchdowns in relief this season (Yahoo).
WagerTalk and BettingPros both like UCLA with the points; the line has moved from Oregon by 12.5 to 11.5 (WagerTalk). Cool with a chance of rain at Autzen, which is outdoors.
cfb:26OCT10UCLAORE.summary: Oregon quarterback Dante Moore is officially out with a concussion, so transfer Dylan Raiola makes his first start for the Ducks against an unbeaten UCLA team averaging nearly 45 points a game. Oregon is also missing a starting receiver, a running back and a starting lineman, with a starting safety doubtful. Oregon is still favored by about 11 or 12.

cfb:26OCT10UGAALA.lean: No strong lean. The weather risk and the coin-flip line make this one to watch rather than bet.
news: Alabama athletics says there are no plans to change the game; meteorologist James Spann now calls the Saturday-night forecast favorable with winds under 15 mph (SI, 247Sports, On3).
Georgia running back Chauncey Bowens, receiver Thomas Blackshear and safety Tyriq Green are out; Nate Frazier is back (247Sports).
Alabama edge rushers Justin Hill and Desmond Umeozulu are expected to miss again; right tackle Jayvin James looks set to return (Roll Bama Roll).
The line flipped from Georgia favored to Alabama favored by 1.5; Covers, WagerTalk and NBC all lean Georgia with the points (WagerTalk, Covers).
Bryant-Denny Stadium is outdoors; a postponement to Sunday was the fallback plan if conditions worsened.
cfb:26OCT10UGAALA.summary: Two unbeaten teams in Tuscaloosa with Hurricane Isaias passing through Alabama. As of Thursday the game is still on at 7:30 Eastern, and the local forecast now has the worst wind and rain moving through Saturday morning with just lingering showers and light wind by kickoff. Alabama is favored by a point or two after Georgia opened as the favorite; most analysts lean Georgia.
